articles.title: Presidente da Venezuela agradece apoio do Brasil
articles.summary: Lula discussed with Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez Brazil's humanitarian assistance following earthquakes that killed over 4,000 people in late June, including medical supplies and a field hospital.

articles.title: Lula defende acordo do Mercosul com China durante Cúpula do bloco
articles.summary: During the Mercosul Summit in Asunción, Lula advocated for the bloc to initiate negotiations with China for a trade agreement and criticized automatic alignment and exclusionary choices.

articles.title: "Melhor arma que um país pode ter é alimento", diz Lula
articles.summary: At the launch of the 2026/2027 Crop Plan, Lula encouraged family farmers to use available financing resources and discussed reducing interest rates for agricultural credit.

articles.title: PF conclui que Flávio Bolsonaro cometeu calúnia contra Lula nas redes
articles.summary: The Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed libel against President Lula in social media posts falsely attributing crimes including drug trafficking and money laundering.
